title: Solid Core vs. Cellular Core PVC in Drainage
description: Understanding the structural differences between solid core and cellular core PVC is essential for proper DWV pipe selection. Solid core PVC features uniform solid plastic throughout its wall, offering high structural strength, impact resistance, and superior sound damping properties. Cellular core PVC, also known as foam core, incorporates a middle foam layer sandwiched between solid outer layers. This construction makes cellular core lighter and more cost-effective for non-pressure drainage applications. However, installers must verify local code approvals, as some jurisdictions restrict cellular core usage.

Solid Core vs. Cellular Core PVC in Drainage

Understanding the structural differences between solid core and cellular core PVC is essential for proper DWV pipe selection. Solid core PVC features uniform solid plastic throughout its wall, offering high structural strength, impact resistance, and superior sound damping properties. Cellular core PVC, also known as foam core, incorporates a middle foam layer sandwiched between solid outer layers. This construction makes cellular core lighter and more cost-effective for non-pressure drainage applications. However, installers must verify local code approvals, as some jurisdictions restrict cellular core usage.
